## How to Connect the Fathom MCP Server

Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more. This guide walks you through setup on each supported platform.

## Choose your assistant

[![](https://mintcdn.com/fathom-e4df0608/AEC-X4jFplvaRPpa/images/mcp-openai.svg?fit=max&auto=format&n=AEC-X4jFplvaRPpa&q=85&s=04f58adf9a687318bb186120a128fc96)
ChatGPT
Connect to the Fathom app in ChatGPT](/mcp-docs/chatgpt)[![](https://mintcdn.com/fathom-e4df0608/AEC-X4jFplvaRPpa/images/mcp-claude.svg?fit=max&auto=format&n=AEC-X4jFplvaRPpa&q=85&s=d2f891fb486f17463e4b0df958c45507)
Claude
Connect to the Fathom connector in Claude, or add the MCP in Claude Code](/mcp-docs/claude)

## Use with other tools

Connect Fathom to any MCP-compatible tool using the server URL below, then authenticate to access your meeting data. **MCP server URL:** `https://api.fathom.ai/mcp`
